samples.question: Five panels sit side by side and are read left to right. The leftmost panel is the START panel: it shows a horizontal rail divided into five slots, slot 0 at the left up to slot 4 at the right, with a single magenta marker on one slot. An orange ring around the marker marks the START slot index of a register. The four panels to the right are OPERATOR panels, read left to right; each holds one coloured triangle. A green right-pointing triangle advances the register's value by one (+1) and a red left-pointing triangle retreats it by one (-1). Apply the four operators in order from the ringed start; the register's value after each step is start plus the running sum of the steps. What is the MAXIMUM distance from the start value the register ever reaches across the whole replay (counting the start as distance 0)? Answer with the integer 0, 1, 2, 3, or 4.
